records.name: payment.provider.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <group name="payment_followup" position="attributes">

                    0

records.name: payment.provider.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Payment Providers" create="false">
                <field name="sequence" widget="handle"/>
                <field name="name"/>
                <field name="code" groups="base.group_no_one"/>
                <field name="state"/>
                <field name="available_country_ids" widget="many2many_tags" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="company_id" groups="base.group_multi_company" optional="show"/>
            </list>
        </field>

records.name: payment.provider.search
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <search>
                <field name="name" string="provider" filter_domain="[('name', 'ilike', self)]"/>
                <field name="payment_method_ids" string="payment method" context="{'active_test': False}" filter_domain="[                             '|',                             ('payment_method_ids.name', 'ilike', self),                             ('payment_method_ids.code', 'ilike', self),                        ]"/>
                <filter name="provider_installed" string="Installed" domain="[('module_state', '=', 'installed')]"/>
                <group>
                    <filter string="Provider" name="code" context="{'group_by': 'code'}"/>
                    <filter string="State" name="state" context="{'group_by': 'state'}"/>
                    <filter string="Company" name="company" context="{'group_by': 'company_id'}" groups="base.group_multi_company"/>
                </group>
            </search>
        </field>

records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <group name="provider_credentials" position="before">
                <button string="Connect" name="action_start_onboarding" type="object" invisible="code != 'payu' or payu_key_id" colspan="2" class="btn-primary mb-2"/>
                <button string="Disconnect" name="action_reset_credentials" type="object" confirm="Are you sure you want to disconnect?" invisible="code != 'payu' or not payu_key_id" class="btn-secondary mb-2"/>
            </group>
            <group name="provider_credentials" position="inside">
                <group name="payu_credentials" invisible="code != 'payu'" groups="base.group_no_one">
                    <field string="Key ID" name="payu_key_id"/>
                    <field string="Merchant Salt" name="payu_merchant_salt" password="True"/>
                </group>
            </group>
        </field>
